newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys 35,000 tonnes sunflower and palm oil.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys 35,000 tonnes sunflower and palm oil.

text.p: Egypt bought 35,000 tonnes of vegetable oil on Wednesday for delivery in the first half of January, an official from the state Holding Company for Food Industries said.
Head of sales Muharram Ghanem told Reuters the breakdown was as follows -
- 25,000 tonnes +/- five percent of sunflower oil at $537 C+F Alexandria from Toepfer International.
- 10,000 tonnes +/- five percent of palm oil at $546.75 C+F Alexandria from Felda International of Malaysia.
